title: a child, a passion, and a mission to fill the gap: affective, social, and personal impacts of a german minority community archive
core_idea: Using empirical data, especially interviews from August 2024, the paper examines an independent community archive (the German Minority Research Center in Silesia) to explore its goals to preserve German identity and language, document and popularize community history, and to investigate the archive's social, affective, and personal impacts on the community and contributors.
tldr: Empirical study of a German minority community archive in Silesia that investigates the archive's aims to preserve identity and language, document community history, and the social, affective, and personal dimensions of its work.
